payload.name: CaptureAllEnumeratedItems
payload.description: When a user message lists multiple distinct items, extract and retain every item in memory content; do not omit any when summarizing or updating.
content: During extraction, if a message enumerates two or more distinct items (e.g., separated by commas, conjunctions, or bullet points), include each item explicitly in the candidate content. Avoid summaries that may drop list elements; paraphrase minimally and keep all listed specifics.

During CRUD, compare new evidence against existing memories: if an item from an enumerated list is missing from the stored memory, update or merge to add that item rather than leaving the memory incomplete.

solves: Memory construction often loses details when a speaker enumerates multiple distinct items in one message; the resulting memory is incomplete and fails to support claims about dropped elements. This skill ensures extraction and CRUD preserve every explicitly listed item, so future questions about any element can be answered. It applies to any topic where a user lists multiple attributes, reasons, preferences, or experiences.
